stories.title: Windows 11’s ‘whole ISO’ squeezed into a CD-ROM
stories.summary: Professional Windows crusher NTDEV has showcased their next-generation tool for compressing Windows 11 with a video of an install that fits on a single CD-ROM.

stories.title: Cadence reveals Maestro, fine-tuned AI models built to run specialized chip design agents, with early access coming for 'select customers' in Q4 2026
stories.summary: Cadence unveiled Maestro, domain-specialized AI models for its chip design agents, with early access for select customers in Q4 2026.

stories.title: Chinese research vessels loiter near Pacific undersea cables more than any other nation, report finds
stories.summary: Chinese vessels are spending more time near undersea cables in the Pacific than nearly 50 other nations, according to a new report by the Center for Strategic and International Studies.

stories.title: Intel's Lip-Bu Tan has spoken with Lisa Su about potential collaboration with AMD
stories.summary: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan has reportedly discussed potential areas of cooperation with AMD chief Lisa Su as Intel works to rebuild its CPU business and expand its foundry operations. The companies have already collaborated on x86 standards and CPU software, including AMD’s integration of its ZenDNN optimizations into Intel’s oneDNN library. Neither executive has publicly detailed the reported discussions or confirmed a new agreement.

stories.title: Save over $1,000 on this Alienware gaming PC with an RTX 5070 and 32GB DDR5
stories.summary: Newegg have cut this Alienware Aurora gaming PC by over $1,000, netting yo ua 4K-ready machine with an RTX 5070 and 32GB of DDR5 RAM for $2,199.99.
